note: The labels every repo carries. Kind lives in the issue type (Bug, Feature, Task), which is set by the org issue forms in .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE. Priority is a label because issue fields cannot be filtered by the search API that gh-dash uses.

canonical.name: priority:00-close-now
canonical.description: Nobody should work on this. Close it, or mark it not planned.

canonical.name: priority:10-now
canonical.description: Do this before anything else in the org.

canonical.name: priority:50-deferred
canonical.description: Parked on purpose. Revisit only if something changes.

canonical.name: security
canonical.description: Touches memory safety, key material, or a protocol invariant.

canonical.name: blocked
canonical.description: Waiting on something outside this issue. Say what in a comment.

canonical.name: good first issue
canonical.description: Small, self-contained, and written up well enough for a first pull request.

canonical.name: help wanted
canonical.description: Nobody here is on it. A pull request is welcome.
